title: Kill Overlay
description: It shows a custom text when you die or kill someone.It also has a combo with a auto text feature where it will send a customizable message in the chat when you die or kill someone! counter It has adjustable setting in the ui and /killoverlay commands too!
body: It is a mode that shows a custom text when you die or kill someone. You can customize everything in the UI.You do anything in the UI! There is also a auto chat feature that types in a custom text when you die or kill someone. There is also a section for it in the UI to customize it.But there is more! There is a feature that will calculate your combo in pvp! There is a UI section for it too so you can adjust anything + there are /killoverlay commands.To open the UI you can press the button K on your keyboard for the UI to open. Also note that this mod only works with real players but for the combo to reset, even if you take damage from a mob, it will reset. Cloth config and Fabric Api is required for this mod to run.
